title: Diagnostic
spec: Swim to the light and touch it.
author: @Cy-3LO

say: This swimmer comes with an **Eye** wired to a **Thruster**, yet it does not move.
Press the **Board** button or tab, or press Tab.
Open **Diagnostic** by choosing the stethoscope, or pressing **D**.
At its top, your board at work. At its foot, the map: your swimmer and the light.
Drag it round the light and turn it with the mouse wheel: when does its eye see the light?
